Data.Subject: Old expense report rejected - over 90 days
Data.Body: I found a conference expense from last quarter that never got filed, and Concur rejected my report saying it's too old. Is there any way to still get reimbursed?
Data.Rationale: The ticket is a reimbursement-policy question related to an expense report, so Billing is the closest category and the impact is Low. SupportKB states that expense reports are filed in Concur and that reports over 90 days old require VP approval; approved reports pay out on the next weekly Thursday cycle. The KB does not specify the exact internal workflow for obtaining or attaching VP approval, so the draft keeps that guidance general.
Data.Draftreply:
Hi Greg,

Thanks for reaching out. Concur rejects reports that are over 90 days old unless they have VP approval, so there may still be a path to reimbursement for the conference expense.

Please request VP approval for the expense report and include that approval with the report in Concur. Once a report is approved, standard reimbursements pay out on the next weekly cycle on Thursdays.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
